prompts.subject: Chemistry
prompts.title: Mole Concept and Chemical Calculations
prompts.prompt:
Create a wide cinematic hero banner, 1916×821, for an O Level Chemistry ala-carte class on Mole Concept and Chemical Calculations.

The image should feel like a premium futuristic science tuition banner: dark navy and black background, warm orange-gold glow, subtle amber particles, soft bloom, high contrast, atmospheric depth, realistic 3D objects mixed with elegant holographic scientific diagrams. Match the vibe of a glowing chemistry banner with formulas and lab glassware.

Main composition: place the main visual slightly right of center, leaving the left and lower-left area darker and less busy for website text overlay. In the center-right, show a glowing volumetric flask, conical flask, weighing balance, and gas syringe arranged like a sleek chemistry calculation workstation. Inside and around the glassware, show tiny luminous molecular particles flowing between containers, suggesting reacting masses, molar volume, and concentration.

Add abstract holographic overlays: ratio lines, mole particle clusters, formula-like symbols, arrows between reactants and products, volume markings, and a faint grid of calculation steps — but make all text and equations decorative and unreadable, like elegant glowing scientific glyphs rather than real words. Include a subtle balance-scale motif to represent stoichiometric ratios. Add warm amber light from the glassware and tiny teal highlights in the shadows.

The image should feel precise, analytical, and high-achieving — like students mastering calculations step by step. Keep the overall mood dramatic, polished, and modern. No people, no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
